description: Er-doped aluminosilicate, 9.0 mol% Al2O3 (Simpson thesis fibre Al-7); classical MD melt-quench

potential.name: Pedone, Malavasi, Menziani, Cormack, Segre, J. Phys. Chem. B 110, 11780 (2006) (PMMCS), rigid-ion partial-charge
potential.functional_form: U_ij(r) = q_i q_j e^2/(4 pi eps0 r) + D_ij[(1-exp(-a_ij(r-r0_ij)))^2 - 1] + C_ij/r^12  (LAMMPS pair_style pedone + coul/long)
potential.primary_paper_note: The 2006 paper itself (DOI 10.1021/jp0611018) could not be read in this session (ACS page and the only free PDF mirror were blocked). Every number below was taken from a secondary source that reproduces the Pedone table; Si-O, Al-O, O-O are cross-checked in 2-3 independent sources; Er-O comes from a single source (code), whose Si/Al/O entries agree digit-for-digit with the cross-checked literature values.

potential.cation_cation: Coulomb only (as in the Pedone model)

cutoffs.note: 7.5 A short-range cutoff as in Gong & Olivetti Table 2

protocol.ensemble: NVT, fixed experimental density 2.28 g/cm3, cubic box L=35.719 A
protocol.initial: random placement, min distance 1.7 A, per-replica seed; CG minimisation (<=2000 iter)
protocol.quench_rate_note: Planned 10 K/ps (5 K/ps unaffordable: only 2 cores, ~70 steps/s per replica). The first 10 K/ps quench of both replicas was killed at 370 ps (T~490 K) by a sandbox restart with no mid-quench restart file, so both replicas were re-quenched from their saved end-of-3500-K states at 15 K/ps with a 30 ps (not 50 ps) 300 K stage to fit the budget.
protocol.sampling: 10 frames, every 2 ps over the last 20 ps (t=12..30 ps of the 300 K stage)

timing.hardware: 2 CPU cores (nproc=2); replicas run concurrently, 1 MPI rank each
timing.run1_lost: first attempt 23:54-01:19 UTC: high 20 ps ~305 s, melt 50 ps ~722 s, 10 K/ps quench reached 370 ps (~490 K) before a sandbox restart killed both processes; no dumps from it

ligand_tag_legend: BO-X-Y: bridging O bonded to formers X,Y (Si within 2.0 A, Al within 2.1 A); NBO-X: non-bridging, one former; free_O: no former; TBO: >=3 formers (tricluster). ligands are O within r_min of the Er, minimum image, A, sorted by distance
